title: PostgreSQL via SQLx: migrations, pool, example domain
objective: PostgreSQL as transactional truth via SQLx: migrations, pooling, transactions, UUIDv7 ids, timestamps, indexes, health checks, slow-query visibility, example domain.
acceptance_criteria: Migrations apply cleanly to an empty database and are re-runnable
DB integration tests pass against a real PostgreSQL
/readyz reports database status; DB outage yields 503 not a crash
validation: cargo test -p blueprint-db -- --include-ignored against docker postgres
